parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, made of durable plastic, typically rectangular with rounded edges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the sitting surface for the user, supporting body weight comfortably.
parts.Movement_description: It can fold upward or downward along the hinge mechanism when the chair is folded or unfolded.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the folding chair, made of tubular steel for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and backrest, providing structural integrity and allowing the folding mechanism to operate.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots at the joints to allow the chair to fold flat for storage or unfold for use.
